eval: (async () => { const ta = document.querySelector('textarea'); if (!ta) return 'no-textarea'; const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 4; c.height = 4; c.getContext('2d').fillRect(0,0,4,4); const blob = await new Promise(r => c.toBlob(r, 'image/png')); const f = new File([blob], 'paste.png', { type: 'image/png' }); const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(f); const ev = new Event('paste', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); Object.defineProperty(ev, 'clipboardData', { value: dt, configurable: true }); ta.dispatchEvent(ev); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900)); const clip = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => (b.getAttribute('title') || '').includes('图片')); return { clipTitle: clip ? clip.getAttribute('title') : null }; })()
